other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage during Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target-based features (e.g., token log-odds) using the entire training dataset's labels before creating cross-validation splits. This leaks the validation labels into the training features, artificially inflating out-of-fold performance estimates and biasing the ensemble weights.

other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage during Preprocessing
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits unsupervised preprocessing steps like SVD, NMF, and Imputation on the entire training dataset before cross-validation splitting. This leaks information from validation folds into the training features during the cross-validation loop.

summary: The agent implements a sophisticated solution with extensive feature engineering, multiple models, and a robust optimization-based ensembling strategy (SLSQP on rank-transformed OOF predictions). However, it commits a critical error by performing target encoding (log-odds calculation) on the entire training set before cross-validation, leading to massive target leakage. Additionally, unsupervised preprocessing steps like SVD and imputation are also fitted prior to the CV split, causing further validation leakage.
